title: Extract duplicated date-range clamping
instruction: In lib/reports.js, the date range clamping logic is duplicated in three functions (weeklyReport, monthlyReport, quarterlyReport). Extract it into a new exported function `clampDateRange(startIso, endIso)` in a new file `lib/dateRange.js` that returns `{ start, end }` as ISO strings, and use it from all three functions. All existing behavior must be preserved - run `node main.js` to verify the demo output stays the same.
